team.title: Meet the team
team.intro: Book with someone you know, or tell us what you'd like and we'll match you with the right stylist.

members.name: Isla Moreno
members.bio: Isla opened The Colour Room in 2016 after ten years colouring in London. She's known for the corrections other salons turn away, and for always telling you what's realistic.

members.name: Priya Shah
members.bio: Priya's lived-in blondes and soft brunettes grow out beautifully, so you can go longer between visits. She also leads the salon's grey-blending appointments.

members.name: Tom Achebe
members.bio: Tom trained in curly cutting in New York and cuts every curl type dry. He's the person to see for a bold new shape or a precise, swingy bob.

members.name: Ellie Hart
members.bio: Ellie loves pastels and vivids, and the planning that keeps them looking good as they fade. She also styles most of our bridal parties.

items.author: Rachel D.

faqs.title: Good to know
faqs.intro: Anything else, just ask. We reply within one working day.

items.question: Do you take walk-ins?
items.answer: No, we're appointments only, so every client gets their stylist's full attention. Book online any time, or call and we'll find you a slot.

items.question: Why do I need a patch test?
items.answer: Colour can cause a reaction even if you've used it before. We test a tiny amount behind your ear at least 48 hours before your appointment. It's free and takes five minutes.

items.question: How long does a colour appointment take?
items.answer: Most take two to four hours. Balayage and corrections can take longer, and we'll give you a time at your consultation.

items.question: What's the difference between stylist levels?
items.answer: Experience. Every stylist is fully trained; senior stylists and creative directors have more years behind the chair and advanced colour training, which is reflected in the price.

items.question: Can I bring reference photos?
items.answer: Please do. Photos help us understand the tone and depth you love, and anything you definitely don't want.

items.question: Do you do bridal hair?
items.answer: Yes, in the salon or on location within 15 miles, with a trial beforehand. Fill in the weddings and events form and we'll send a quote.

items.question: Is the salon accessible?
items.answer: The styling floor and basins are on the ground floor, with step-free access from Boyces Avenue and an accessible loo. Let us know if you need anything else.

policies.title: Booking policies
policies.intro: Fair for you and for our stylists.

items.title: Deposits
items.body: Colour appointments over £100 need a £20 deposit, taken when you book and taken off your bill.

items.title: Cancelling or moving
items.body: Give us 48 hours' notice and we'll move your appointment or refund your deposit. With less notice, the deposit covers your stylist's time.

items.title: Running late
items.body: We'll always try to fit you in. If you're more than 15 minutes late we may need to shorten or rebook your appointment.

items.title: Colour guarantee
items.body: Not quite right? Tell us within 7 days and we'll adjust your colour free of charge.
